expected._comment: inherited from the frozen v1 dataset so that make_ctx validates against the same split sizes

variants._comment: the J-series variants are NOT retrained here; the key exists only because j_series_train_eval.build_manifest records it. R1_dist is trained by j_series_resource_dist_train_eval.py.

core_success._comment: unchanged from the frozen J line; the Phase R line adds its own gates under 'gates'
core_success.primary: RuntimeQScore = mean(PB_0.50, PB_0.90, PB_0.95) on raw ms

resource_dist._comment: Phase R line: replaces the 3-point quantile resource head with a coherent discrete distribution. The frozen J3 encoder and every other head stay untouched; R1 trains only the new head on cached resource features.
resource_dist._binning_note: mass_balanced: one dedicated near-zero metadata bin plus empirical-quantile log bins; every non-metadata bin must hold at least max(200, 0.5% of train positive slots) samples, and the overflow bin starts above train p99.5 instead of p99.9

stages.R1_dist: distribution head only, frozen J3 features, linear head
stages.R1b_mlp: same frozen features, 128 -> 64 GELU -> 16 head (second model-selection run)
stages.R2_activity: NOT ENABLED: needs slot_activity labels, absent from j_series_dataset_v1
stages.R3_joint: NOT ENABLED: only after R2 passes its gates

gates._comment: pre-registered in the R1 code review. TWO TIERS: 'viability' decides whether this direction is worth continuing, 'strong' is the paper-level success bar. All thresholds are READ BY THE CODE from this block.

protocol.test_look: only via --stage test-final for a locked winner; refuses to overwrite without --force
protocol.epoch_rule: 30 epochs, no early stopping; among calibration-eligible epochs pick argmin val log-MAE, tie-break higher Spearman; save best and last
protocol.first_arm: Linear head (hidden=null); the MLP arm is a separate, pre-registered model-selection run
